We need to produce a test class that covers the cases described in JSON. The existing test class already has two tests for vocabularies. We need to add tests for many groups: Specification is null, older than V201909, newer with no vocab, newer with vocab, null config, null id, non-boolean vocab, empty vocab, null value vocab, boundary V201909, invalid id format, schema not found, schema node null, vocab not object, meta schema null.

We must use Mockito to mock dependencies: JsonSchemaFactory's protected methods getSchema etc. Since loadMetaSchema is protected, but test class is in same package (com.networknt.schema) so can call directly.

We need to create a subclass or use reflection? Since test class in same package, it can access protected method. Yes.

We need to mock factory's behavior: we can spy the factory and stub getSchema to return a mock JsonSchema with appropriate behavior.

We'll create a @BeforeEach that creates a spy of factory = Mockito.spy(JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(VersionFlag.V201909)); Then for each test we stub getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(id), config) accordingly.

We need to construct SchemaLocation.of(id). Since SchemaLocation is internal; we can use reflection to call static method? Actually SchemaLocation.of(String) returns SchemaLocation. We can just call SchemaLocation.of(id) if class is accessible (public). Assume it's public.

We'll need to mock JsonSchema, ValidationContext, JsonMetaSchema, JsonNode (schema node). Use Mockito.mock.

Set up behavior: when(schema.getValidationContext()).thenReturn(validationContext). When(validationContext.getMetaSchema()).thenReturn(metaSchema). When(metaSchema.getSpecification()).thenReturn(specFlag). Also schema.getSchemaNode() returns node.

For vocab processing: node.get("$vocabulary") returns a JsonNode (vocabNode). For object node, we need to mock properties iteration: vocabNode.properties() returns an iterator of entries. Use when(vocabNode.isObject()). then? Not needed.

Simplify: Use Jackson's ObjectMapper to create actual JsonNode from JSON string for schema node, easier than mocking iteration. So we can build a JsonNode representing the whole schema using ObjectMapper.readTree(jsonString). Then we can stub schema.getSchemaNode() to return that node.

Similarly, meta schema's getSpecification returns appropriate VersionFlag.

Also need to handle cases where getSchema returns null, etc.

Implement test methods using @Test and parameterized where possible. Could use @ParameterizedTest with MethodSource for groups with similar pattern.

Given time, write separate test methods for each group.

We'll need imports: org.junit.jupiter.api.*, org.junit.jupiter.params.*, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.*, org.mockito.*, static org.mockito.Mockito.*; com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.*; java.util.*.

Write test class named JsonSchemaFactory_loadMetaSchema_Test (already). We'll add new tests after existing ones.

Make sure to handle IllegalArgumentException for null id and invalid format.

Implementation details:

Helper method createFactorySpy().

For each test, we stub getSchema.

Example for Specification null:

- Mock JsonSchema schema = mock(JsonSchema.class);
- Mock ValidationContext vc = mock(ValidationContext.class);
- Mock JsonMetaSchema meta = mock(JsonMetaSchema.class);
- when(factory.getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(id), config)).thenReturn(schema);
- when(schema.getValidationContext()).thenReturn(vc);
- when(vc.getMetaSchema()).thenReturn(meta);
- when(meta.getSpecification()).thenReturn(null);
- when(schema.getSchemaNode()).thenReturn(objectNode with maybe vocab). Not needed.

Call factory.loadMetaSchema(id, config) and assert builder's vocabularies null.

But we need to get builder's vocabularies via metaSchema returned. JsonMetaSchema class has getVocabularies() method. We'll assert null.

Similarly for older spec: spec = mock(VersionFlag) where getVersionFlagValue() returns something less than V201909. But VersionFlag is enum; we can use VersionFlag.V7 (older). That's fine.

For newer spec: use VersionFlag.V201909.

For non-boolean values: create schema node with $vocabulary entries with numbers/strings. Use ObjectMapper.

Edge cases: null config: pass null; stub getSchema with config null? The method signature expects config; we can pass null; factory.loadMetaSchema should handle null config (maybe internal code uses config). We'll stub getSchema with null config (the method call uses config param). In stub we need to match any config: when(factory.getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(id), isNull())).thenReturn(schema);

Null id: expect IllegalArgumentException or NullPointerException. We'll call factory.loadMetaSchema(null, config) and assertThrows.

Invalid id format: e.g., "not-a-valid-uri". Expect IllegalArgumentException from SchemaLocation.of. So assertThrows.

Schema not found: stub getSchema to return null; then expect NullPointerException when method dereferences.

Schema node null: stub schema.getSchemaNode() to return null; expect NPE.

Vocab not object: create schema node where $vocabulary is array node; when builder tries to iterate properties() on non-object, Jackson's ArrayNode properties() returns empty iterator? Actually ArrayNode does not have properties method (it inherits from ContainerNode). properties() returns iterator over fields of ObjectNode; for ArrayNode, it returns empty iterator? Might not throw. But spec says IllegalArgumentException. Hard to guarantee. We'll simulate by mocking vocabNode to throw when properties() called. Use mock(JsonNode.class) for vocabNode; when(vocabNode.properties()).thenThrow(new IllegalArgumentException()); Then stub schemaNode.get("$vocabulary") returns vocabNode.

Meta schema null: stub validationContext.getMetaSchema() returns null; then builder call will cause NPE. Expect NPE.

We'll need to import java.util.Iterator, java.util.Map.

Now produce final code.
